|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Ground Slam''' is a [[melee]] [[attack]] creating a wave that travels forwards and damages enemies with an increased chance to [[stun]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Accuracy]]''': Accuracy is a factor despite the nature of the skill. Ground Slam can miss. * '''[[Dual Wielding]]''': Using Ground Slam while dual wielding will alternate between weapons. * '''Reduced Enemy Stun Threshold''': This essentially means that enemies struck by Ground Slam have a greater chance to be [[stun]]ned than with other attacks. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_header = Deals up to x% more Damage with Hits to closer targets |c1_abbr = Close Target Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals up to (%d+)%% more Damage with Hits to closer targets |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_header = +x metres to radius |c2_abbr = Radius |c2_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c2_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill threshold jewel list|stat_id=ground_slam}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1, scaling up to 11 at gem level 20 (previously 6 at all gem levels). * Now has 132% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 115%), scaling up to 356% at gem level 20 (previously 188%). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes the skill to deal up +0-20% more Damage with Hits to closer targets, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect and 0-20% increased Stun Duration on enemies. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.1| * Updated various descriptions of conditional modifiers, such as the {{c|mod|increased Damage against Ignited Enemies}} modifier on {{il|Gang's Momentum}}, to clarify the kinds of damage they can apply to. * Updated {{c|mod|Deals up to (40-49)% more Damage to closer targets}} to {{c|mod|Deals up to (40-49)% more Damage with Hits to closer targets}}.
